design_philosophy: A professional, enterprise-grade Dark Mode interface inspired by Vercel and Linear. It utilizes deep navy/charcoal tones combined with sharp electric blue accents to create a command-center feel. The design relies on 1px subtle borders, precise typography, and functional layouts (like the 2x2 camera grid and lateral event timeline) to project reliability, security, and advanced AI capability without overwhelming the user.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Add '@phosphor-icons/react' for professional SaaS icons, 'recharts' for Admin metrics, and 'lucide-react' if Shadcn requires it.
FONTS: Import 'Outfit' (weights 400,600,700) and 'Manrope' (weights 400,500,600) via Google Fonts in index.css.

LAYOUT STRATEGY: Build a persistent sidebar on the left and a top header. The main dashboard should feature a 2x2 camera grid in the main column and a vertical timeline of AI events on the right (lateral timeline).
DARK MODE ONLY: Hardcode the application to dark mode. Use the colors specified in this guideline (e.g., bg-[#090A0F] for the body, bg-[#12141D] for cards).
CAMERA PLACEHOLDERS: Use the 'live_feed_container' style for the 2x2 grid. Add a pulsing red dot and 'LIVE' badge on each feed. Include overlay controls (zoom, settings) that appear on hover.
TESTING: Ensure every interactive element (buttons, forms, camera feeds, timeline items) has a descriptive 'data-testid' (e.g., 'data-testid="login-submit-button"', 'data-testid="camera-feed-1"').
LANDING PAGE: Implement a sleek hero section using the 'hero_background' image with a heavy black overlay. Highlight features like YOLOv8n detection, Google Drive sync, and WhatsApp alerts.
SUPER ADMIN: Use Shadcn Tables (customized with dark mode borders) to list users, devices, and plans. Avoid purely white text; use text-gray-300 for table cells to maintain the sleek aesthetic.
